Preparation Strategy for Punjab Exams

Method beats motivation. This section collects the practical side of preparation: how to plan a day, how to plan a week, what to revise and how to turn a mock test score into a to-do list.

Quick answer

Strategy pages cover study plans, daily and weekly timetables, book recommendations, revision cycles, mock test method, mistake analysis and time management. Each one is written to be used this week rather than someday, and every method ends in a link to free practice on this portal.
